01 — About

I'm Suraj Adhikary, a first-year B.Tech student in CSE & Data Science at Bhubaneswar Engineering College (BEC), Odisha. My goal: become a Data Analyst who turns raw data into real business decisions.

I document my entire learning journey publicly through suraj.analytics on Instagram and YouTube — from Excel dashboards to Python and Power BI — proving consistent public work beats a fancy background.

Current roadmap: Excel → SQL → Python → Power BI, one verifiable project at a time. Every project is real, every number is backed by data.

Off-screen: BGMI, IPL cricket, consumer tech deep-dives from Malkangiri.
